This directory holds the store-v1 schema fixture (20261015000001_store_v1_initial.sql), the parity target for the embedded migrations checked by TestStoreV1FixtureMatchesEmbeddedSchemaMinusOmittedObjects in internal/db/store_v1_schema_test.go. The initial snapshot remains unchanged; subsequent additive migrations are mirrored here so the parity test continues to compare the complete schema, including `session_agent_depth`. The invalid `ListNewFiles` query (a nonexistent `files.is_new` column, no callers) was removed together with the regenerated DB files as part of the H4 sqlc update.
